name: io.github.reality-opened/openreality-mcp
title: Open Reality
description: Phone video to an AI-queryable 3D scene: reconstruct, measure, plan paths, export robot data.

environmentVariables.name: OPENREALITY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Server base URL. Leave unset for the hosted service; point it at your own self-hosted server otherwise.

environmentVariables.name: OPENREALITY_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: API token. Optional: running `npx openreality-mcp login` once stores a key on this machine instead.
